summary: Phase 2.4C — Email tracking (open/click pixel+redirect), /api/super-admin/email-logs endpoint, ClinicIn.primary_color branding, and onboarding email functions. 42/42 backend tests PASS (18 new for 2.4C + 24 regression from 2.4B, 1 skipped by design). Super Admin 'Emails' tab renders correctly with 11 real email rows showing Data/Para/Assunto/Status/Abertura/Cliques columns and open/click tracking working end-to-end (fired /api/email-tracking/open/{id}.png and .../click/{id}?u=... on live logs and confirmed open_count=1/click_count=1 with opened_at/clicked_at ISO timestamps). Primary color input renders on /minha-clinica with data-testid='clinic-primary-color' and PUT /api/clinic persists primary_color correctly (backend-verified).

minor.issue: No pagination/filters (limit query param exists, default 200 hard-cap). Fine for now; will need next(offset) as volume grows.
No format validation (accepts any string). Consider `pattern=^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$` to reject invalid hex values.

FRONTEND_URL='https://1372f60d-...emergentagent.com' does NOT match the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. As a result, tracking pixel/click URLs embedded in emails point to the old preview domain (still resolves in emergent infra, but future domain rotations will break existing sent emails). Recommend aligning FRONTEND_URL to the same host as REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

server.py:3811 — email_click_tracking safely gates redirect target with u.startswith(('http://','https://')); javascript:/data:/file: URIs correctly redirect to '/'. Good defensive coding.
server.py:3797 — email_open_tracking still returns 200 image/gif even when email_id is unknown (update_one is a no-op), so pixel loads never break the client's email rendering. Correct behavior.
server.py:3827 — /super-admin/email-logs sorts by sent_at DESC and excludes _id via projection. Good.

server.py:3763 trial_check_loop — 8h tolerance windows (68-76h, 116-124h, 20-28h) around each milestone matches the 1h loop cadence and guarantees each user receives each mail exactly once (bounded by idempotency_key). Good.
server.py file size is now ~3884 lines — earlier recommendation to split into routers/services still stands but is not a 2.4C blocker.

rca_of_the_issue.initial_webhook_test_failure: First run of test_webhook_creates_email_log_with_clinic_id_and_email_id failed because the test webhook payload had externalReference=None. The Asaas webhook handler at server.py:3222 falls back to subscription_ref lookup only when externalReference is empty, and since there was no matching gateway_subscription_id, clinic_id ended up None and no email was triggered. The test picked up an unrelated stale email_log from a prior iteration. Fix: fetch admin's clinic_id via /api/auth/me and set externalReference=clinic_id in the webhook payload — then confirmed new email_log gets email_id=em_<12hex> and clinic_id populated correctly (test now passes).
